History and Fiction
An unofficial interactive fable inspired by Jensen Huang's journey. Combat abilities, narration, stats, and endings are original creations. The finale is entirely fictional; its ten directors use public names, but their positions and actions in the game are invented. Combat visuals are drawn in code. One original three-founder concept thumbnail is included; it is not a historical photograph or a verified likeness. There is no soundtrack; existing procedural sound effects remain. Historical references follow the frozen design; enemies and combat are creative metaphors. Play works offline.
The Ten Seats · A Fictional Confrontation
The directors' names come from a public roster; seat roles are game metaphors. Their positions, dialogue, attacks, and conflicts are invented and do not represent real views or actions. The shared blockade is a stage device, not a claim about real votes or conspiracies.
